verdict.rationale: Canny is a SaaS feedback platform with AI features such as Autopilot and an MCP server, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, has no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy for model training. The MCP and Autopilot material covers AI features, not data-use controls, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
